title: Embedding + Reranker Regression Attribution and Playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an automated regression attribution playbook and pipeline that ties offline embedding+reranker quality drops to specific model or config changes. The goal is to provide an explainable, actionable report when Recall@100 / Precision@K / MRR / cohort drift exceed thresholds after a model or config rollout. This ticket covers data collection, attribution heuristics, report template, and automation to open follow-up tasks or trigger rollback recommendations.
acceptance_criteria: A nightly attribution job runs after any model/config rollout and produces a human-readable regression report for affected cohorts

Report includes delta table for primary metrics (Recall@10, Recall@100, Precision@k, MRR), effect size per cohort, and a ranked list of suspect config diffs (model_variant, tokenizer, quantization_profile, batch/kv_cache settings)
Automated gating: if global Recall@100 drops by >3% with high confidence (p<0.01) then create ENG ticket and annotate rollout for review
Dashboard tile linking the most recent attribution report and historical trend for each model/config pair
Unit and integration tests for the attribution heuristics and CI job; docs and runbook placed in Confluence
tasks: Design report schema and JSON template for attribution (metrics, cohorts, diffs, evidence snippets)
Extend offline eval harness to emit per-example scoring deltas and nearest-neighbor stability stats
Implement statistical detectors: bootstrap CI for delta, KS test on cosine similarity distributions, and Cohen's d for effect size
Map config diffs to candidate causes using a weighted scoring heuristic (weight factors: surface area, magnitude of change, known-risk tags)
Create a nightly Airflow job that runs attribution after config rollouts and writes reports to S3 and Redash
Add Linear auto-create flow when gating thresholds are exceeded with prefilled diagnostics and links
Instrument console dashboard to display latest attribution report and allow drilldowns to per-cohort examples
decisions: Use Recall@100 and Recall@10 as primary regression signals for reranker+embedding combos; MRR as secondary
Adopt bootstrap-based CI over parametric tests because metric distributions are heavy-tailed in our production cohorts
Score candidate causes by combining config-diff magnitude and correlation with per-example delta instead of only relying on global delta
Thresholds: start conservative (3% global drop / 5% cohort drop) and iterate based on noise observed in the first 4 weeks
